description: Whether the sun is down at a point and an instant: after sunset and before sunrise, the sun's centre 0.833 degrees below the horizon (its upper limb on it; NOAA's solar calculation, the Naval Observatory's definition). Not 14 CFR 1.1's night, which begins only at the end of evening civil twilight: this is the sky as a pilot sees it, the map's day or night glyph.
